Entries.bath_ami/Friendship {{REI}} 1500/Friends:
{{MUSIC_AMI}}
                    /35 38
                    /farmer 35 52 0 {{REI}} -1000 -1000 0 {{AMI}} 36 36 2

                    /-- SHRINE INTRO: AMI --

                    /move farmer 0 -14 0
                    /pause 2000
                    /emote {{AMI}} 56
                    /speak {{AMI}} "oh, hi @."
                    /pause 1000
                    /quickquestion you must be here to buy something?
                      #yes, i'm too busy to talk.
                      #i'm just visiting.
                      (break)pause 1000
                        \speak {{AMI}} "i see...$s#$b#well, maybe another time, then."
                        \eventSeen bath_ami false
                        \addConversationTopic bath_ami 5
                        \end\pause 1
                      (break)pause 1000
                    /speak {{AMI}} "i see.$h"
                    /pause 3500
                    /emote {{AMI}} 40
                    /pause 3000
                    /speak {{AMI}} "um, @. i was thinking..."
                    /pause 2500
                    /speak {{AMI}} "there's a unique geological formation further up the coast from here which i've been meaning to visit...#$b#it's characterised by a sort of, um. localised geothermal activity... in an area of mineral-rich fresh water."
                    /pause 1000
                    /speak {{AMI}} "i've planned a trip with rei this evening, so.."
                    /quickquestion if you'd care to join us ..?
                        #sure! i love rocks
                        #geography activities? i don't think so.
                        (break)pause 1000
                        (break)pause 3500
                            \emote {{AMI}} 28
                            \pause 3000
                            \speak {{AMI}} "that's alright. i thought you might say that.$s"
                            \pause 2500
                            \speak {{AMI}} "enjoy your evening.$s"
                            \action SetNpcInvisible {{REI}} 0
                            \action SetNpcInvisible {{AMI}} 0
                            \friendship {{REI}} -250
                            \friendship {{AMI}} -500
                            \end\pause 1
                    /speak {{AMI}} "great! i see you've got some swimwear already... you'll need it!$h#$b#i'll fetch the car and we can get going."
                    /pause 1000
                    /switchEvent bath
